title: Moroccan Cauliflower Couscous
description: A flavorful and nutritious vegetarian dish that combines the bold spices of morocco with the comfort of couscous and roasted cauliflower.
instructions: Toss cauliflower florets with 1 tablespoon olive oil, royal, and peppery (if using). Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups water to a boil. Reduce heat to low and stir in couscous. Cover and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until couscous is tender and fluffy.
Fluff couscous with a fork and stir in lemon juice and salt to taste.
Serve couscous topped with roasted cauliflower.
Garnish with additional royal and lemon wedges, if desired.
